fields.text: 8/ This is how we #WinTheFuture: Clean air, clean water, and a healthier planet for generations to come. Thank you, @POTUS and @EPA, for your leadership. 👏
7/ The power sector now has a clear path forward to invest in clean energy while maintaining reliable electricity for all Americans. 🌟

6/ These rules are not just about the environment—they’re about justice. Many of the communities affected by power plant pollution are low-income and minority neighborhoods. This is a critical step toward environmental justice. ✊🏽
5/ Coal Ash Management: New rules require safer disposal and cleanup of coal ash, reducing the risk of groundwater contamination and ensuring healthier ecosystems. 🐟🌳

4/ Water Pollution Limits: Power plants will now face stricter regulations on wastewater discharge, preventing over 660 million pounds of pollutants from entering our waters each year. Protecting our lakes and rivers just got a big boost. 💦

3/ Stronger Mercury and Air Toxics Standards (MATS): The EPA has tightened limits on toxic emissions, cutting mercury and other harmful pollutants by up to 70%. This will lead to cleaner air and safer communities. 🏞️

2/ Carbon Pollution Standards: Existing coal and new gas-fired power plants must now control 90% of their carbon emissions. This is a game-changer for reducing greenhouse gases and curbing climate change. 🌎
